descriptionChirho: A Roman provincial governor or administrative ruler exercising imperial authority, such as Pontius Pilate or Felix. All three clusters are purely inflectional variants (singular nominative/accusative/genitive/dative vs plural forms) with identical semantic content across all languages: 'governor(s)' (eng), 'gobernador(es)/gobernantes' (spa), 'mtawala/watawala' (swa), 'raajyapaal/haakim' (hin: governor/magistrate), 'waali/ru'asaa' (arb: governor/leaders), 'chongdok/tongchija' (kor: governor/ruler). The slight lexical variation 'rulers' in S68877 reflects contextual translation choice, not a different sense.
